intro:
Look closely at this image. One thing doesn't belong.
Once you notice it, you can't look away.
description:
A quiet hallway. A room that should be empty. Dolls lined up in neat rows.
— And among them, one "thing that shouldn't be there" is hiding.

A pale, translucent figure.
A single "real one" mixed into a row of dolls and mannequins.
You won't catch it at a glance. But once you find it, you'll never unsee it.

This is a horror observation game where you spot the presence that shouldn't be there inside a single dim image, and tap it.
An extra figure in an empty place, a living person among lined-up statues —
you hunt down that spine-tingling wrongness with nothing but your eyes.
No gore, nothing graphic. The only scary things are the "presence" and the "wrongness" — which is exactly why it creeps up on you.

50 scenes in all.
The further you go, the more cleverly it blends in, and the harder it gets to tell.

How to play is simple.
・Scan every corner of the dim picture
・Find the thing that "shouldn't be there," and tap it gently

The instant you spot it, a chill runs down your spine — that's the reward.
Play alone in a bright room, or shout "Where?!" with a friend.

So, the wrongness hidden in this one image — can you find it?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
